subject: Decision Making
subcategory: Famous Decisions That Changed the World
title: The French Revolution Erupts
description: A 60-second lesson on The French Revolution Erupts.

hook.text: In 1789, Parisians stormed the Bastille. The king had refused every reform.

buildup.text: France was bankrupt. Bread prices soared. The aristocracy rejected every tax reform that might have prevented revolt.

discovery.text: The revolution succeeded but then consumed itself. Robespierre executed thousands, then was executed himself.

twist.text: Napoleon rose from the chaos. The revolution that killed a king ended up creating an emperor.

climax.text: The French Revolution shows that refusing small changes can trigger catastrophic ones. Delayed decisions compound.

punchline.text: Refuse small reforms, get a revolution. Delayed decisions compound.

quiz.question: What decision lesson does the French Revolution teach?
options: Refusing small changes can trigger catastrophic, uncontrollable ones
